sub_sector.value: specialty catastrophe property and casualty insurance; E&S casualty; surety and crop

financial_business_type.detail: Specialty insurer underwriting earthquake, casualty, inland marine, property, crop, surety and credit products.

revenue_driver.detail: Earns premiums on specialty policies, plus investment income on its insurance float.
